newsitem.title: USA: Quaker reviews Snapple for possible charge.
newsitem.headline: Quaker reviews Snapple for possible charge.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said it will review its Snapple beverage operations to see if it must take a charge to reduce the carrying value of the business it bought for nearly $1.8 billion about two years ago.
In a recent Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filing, Quaker said it currently estimates that undiscounted cash flows from Snapple will be sufficient to cover the investment.

"However, given the disappointing performance of the business since its acquisition by the company, management will be updating its assessment later this year in light of additional information which is becoming available with the conclusion of the 1996 beverage season," Quaker said in the filing.
Quaker did not specify the potential size of the charge it might take.
As previously reported, Quaker said it expects Snapple to report an operating loss this year, but less than in 1995.
